domainDefinition: Original frozen v3 alpha>0; common=foreground AND unchanged native baseline/direction finite-depth mask; interior is radius2 Chebyshev binary erosion of common (all 25 neighbors required, outside frame false). Fixed across arms/seeds/cases.
remainingResidualDefinition: Combined minus DirectDiffuse, IndirectDiffuse, DirectGloss, IndirectGloss, Emit and Env. Includes transmission/volume and recomposition error. Those two parts are also reported separately.
linearInteraction: (ON_direction−OFF_direction)−(ON_baseline−OFF_baseline), kept signed; no display transform or energy rescale.
displayScope: Original Combined PNG8 ON vs OFF, same seed; exact integer luma +/-20000 with denominator2550000. Each seed separately, no 8-seed stability inference.
interpretation: ON is source rich character material; OFF is source-rho Lambert roughness0. Material replacement changes diffuse weighting, specular, direct and indirect transport together. This is not isolated specular removal. Finite MC/MIS/adaptive changes and fixed sample_clamp_indirect=10 nonlinear bias remain inseparable with two seeds.
ablationNotLightGroupIsolation: Rich-minus-Lambert is a paired rerender difference including changed BSDF/path/MIS/MC and indirect clamp; not an isolated component light-group.
foregroundCaveat: Original foreground includes boundary and native-missing pixels. Ground is unchanged but may be visible there; full foreground is retained alongside conditional common/interior. No part-whole correlation establishes native repair.
